spans.s: उद्धत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Raised, elevated, लांगूलमुद्धतं धुन्वन् Bt.ix.7, R.ix.60; 2. exceeding, excessive; 3. haughty, vain, अक्षवधोद्धतः R.xii.63; 4. excited, intense, K.S.iii.31; 5. rude, ill-behaved; 6. majestic, धीरोद्धता नमयतीव गति र्धरित्रीम् Ut.vi.
उद्धत (II) m. a king’s wrestler.

उद्धत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Raised, elevated, लांगूलमुद्धतं धुन्वन् Bt.ix.7, R.ix.60; 2. exceeding, excessive; 3. haughty, vain, अक्षवधोद्धतः R.xii.63; 4. excited, intense, K.S.iii.31; 5. rude, ill-behaved; 6. majestic, धीरोद्धता नमयतीव गति र्धरित्रीम् Ut.vi.
उद्धत-मनस्, -मनस्क a. high minded, haughty, proud.
उद्धत-मनस्, -मनस्क a. high minded, haughty, proud.
उद्धति f. 1. Elevation; 2. pride, haughtiness; 3. a stroke.
उद्धम m. 1. Breathing hard; 2. blowing, sounding.

उद्धरण n. 1. Taking out, taking off; 2. extricating, rescuing, दिनानि दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य R.ii.25; 3. lifting, raising; 4. destruction, eradication, कंटकोद्धरणे नित्यमातिष्ठेद्यत्नमुत्तमम् M.ix.252; 5. final emancipation; 6. vomiting; 7. acquittance of debt; 8. anything vomited.
उद्धारण n. 1. Raising, elevating; 2. delivering.
उद्धर्ष m. 1. Courage to undertake a thing; 2. great joy; 3. a festival.
उद्धर्षण n. 1. Animating, encouraging; 2. erection of the hair on the body.
उद्धव m. 1. Sacrificial fire; 2. a festival, a holiday; 3. the name of a Yādava, a friend of Kṛṣṇa. (See App. II.)
उद्धस्त a. (f. स्ता) Raising the hands.
उद्धस्त a. (f. स्ता) Raising the hands.
उद्धान n. 1. Ejecting, vomiting; 2. fireplace.
उद्धांत (I) a. (f. ता) Vomited.
उद्धांत (II) m. An elephant out of rut.
उद्धांत (I) a. (f. ता) Vomited.

उद्धार m. 1. Raising, lifting up; 2. deliverance, redemption; 3. rescuing, extricating; 4. a part to be set aside from patrimony for the benefit of the eldest son (in law); 5. the sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs to the king, M.vii.97; 6. final beatitude; 7. debt.
उद्धुर a. (f. रा) 1. Heavy, full of; 2. thick, gross; 3. firm; 4. able, competent, Bh.V.iv.40.
उद्धुर a. (f. रा) 1. Heavy, full of; 2. thick, gross; 3. firm; 4. able, competent, Bh.V.iv.40.
उद्धूनन n. 1. Throwing upwards; 2. shaking.
उद्धूपन n. Fumigating.
उद्धूषण n. Horripilation, erection of the hair on the body.
उद्धृत a. (f. ता) 1. Raised; 2. delivered, (pp. of हृ with उत् q.v.)
उद्धृत a. (f. ता) 1. Raised; 2. delivered, (pp. of हृ with उत् q.v.)
उद्धृति f. 1. Drawing out; 2. extraction, an extract; 3. delivering, rescuing; 4. rescuing from sin, purifying, finally liberating, त्रपंते तीर्थानि त्वरितमिह यस्योद्धृतिविधौ G.
उद्ध्मान n. A fireplace.
उद्ध्य m. The name of a river, R.xi.8 (उज्झत्युदकमिति उद्ध्यः Mall.)
